The '''S94-T Dealer Droid''' was a model of [[Dealer droid/Legends|dealer droid]] that oversaw [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card games. A S94-T droid was used in the [[Dealer's Den]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in the back room occupied by [[Darmas Pollaran]].
